findings.problem: rows mode reads .tdd-unfrozen from CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR (TS :306/:295, tdd_py_lib.py :424/:493) while the record and the no-ask write are per tree
findings.scenario: worktree pass entered by EnterWorktree path: the gate writes <wt>/.claude/.tdd-unfrozen with no ask, the U2 edit gets the plain frozen deny, writing main's .tdd-unfrozen asks: AC5 fails for every worktree pass
findings.closure: TS and Python freeze hooks read rows-mode entry and listed ids from the edited file's tree (rev-parse --show-toplevel); an LP case runs LP33 from a worktree with CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR = main tree and passes, TS and py.

findings.problem: a row-backed no-ask .tdd-unfrozen line is admitted for a path that is not an existing repo-relative file; the freeze hook then finds no row and falls back to the whole-file substring exemption
findings.scenario: gate row `features/x/x.utils.test.ts | U2 | h` (src/ dropped) approved: line written with no ask, every later edit of src/features/x/x.utils.test.ts passes with no hash check
findings.closure: unfrozen_record_rows (and loop-record.py parse_rows) refuse a row/line whose target is not an existing file at tree/target; an LP case with a suffix-path row gets ask (protect-files) and the record holds no such row.

findings.problem: the case-body depth scan skips strings and // only; a ' inside /* */ or a regex literal opens a string to EOF, so a row case's span swallows the following cases
findings.scenario: U2 (row, title hashed) body holds `/* don't retry */` or `/it's/`; an Edit changing U3's toBe(3) to toBe(99) is allowed (scratch run: exit 0; control without the quote: deny)
findings.closure: the depth loop skips /* */ like the top level, and rows mode refuses when a case span reaches EOF unclosed; LP cases with both U2 bodies and an Edit of U3 get deny.

findings.problem: closable main-tree pass: the main tree is still on the merged feat/<slug> (ship.md:186); step 5 edits land uncommitted on it, `git branch -d` is refused, the next fork bases on the merged branch

findings.problem: ensure_gitignore's append list for an existing kit block lacks .claude/.loop-record.json (only the fresh heredoc has it)
findings.scenario: re-install on a project installed before this pass, worktree pass with no remote: the record is untracked, git worktree remove refuses, 4bis-local clean-up stalls; main tree shows ?? and /loop:tracks reports a dirty tree
findings.closure: .claude/.loop-record.json is in the :634 list, and an IN case on a target whose .gitignore already carries the marker asserts the line is appended.

findings.problem: small lane decides merged from local ancestry, but small tickets with a remote now merge on GitHub (ship.md:276-278); in_loop_slugs ignores awaits_merge
findings.scenario: squash-merged small PR stays in flight forever, counts toward MAX_TRACKS=3, blocks overlapping Files, --status never offers clean-up; a main-tree pass awaiting merge refuses every /loop:small
findings.closure: with a remote, small-dispatch-check S4.4 and small.md --status count a ticket merged when loop-pr-state.sh reads its PR MERGED (D-case: squash-merged ticket not counted), and in_loop_slugs skips an IN LOOP row whose handoff passes awaits_merge unless HEAD is that pass's branch.
